{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline_count}')

# Check assay_batch distribution
print('\nAssay batch distribution:')
print(data['assay_batch'].value_counts())

# Check severity distribution by arm
print('\nSeverity by arm:')
print(pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity']))

# Check if sample_seq > 1 implies re-test
retest_count = (data['sample_seq'] > 1).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with sample_seq > 1: {retest_count}')"}
